description: Capture and publish a new saved page beneath an existing client review link in a writable project. Supply the current baseVersionId and reuse requestId after a lost response. Returns a capture attempt; read history until ready or failed. Does not create invitations, restart reminders, copy feedback, resolve issues, or mark reviewers done. Finishing an initial saved page can fulfil invitations already requested for that link. Requires an explicit request to publish a new version.

baseVersionId.description: Current version ID from history; null only before the first saved version

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

requestId.description: New UUID per capture; reuse for retries after a lost response

reviewId.description: Client review UUID; not the public link token

name: create_client_review_version
